LoraLoaderModelOnly.name: LoraLoaderModelOnly
LoraLoaderModelOnly.description: This LoRAs loader is used to modify the diffusion model, altering the way in which latents are denoised such as applying styles. Multiple LoRA nodes can be linked together.

start_index.tooltip: Start time in seconds, can be negative to count from the end (supports sub-seconds).

TrimAudioDuration.name: TrimAudioDuration
TrimAudioDuration.description: Trim audio tensor into chosen time range.

frame_idx.tooltip: Frame index to anchor the image or the clip's first frame at. Negative values are counted from the end of the video.

vae.tooltip: Video VAE, needed when an image is connected.

audio_vae.tooltip: Audio VAE, needed when an audio is connected.

image.tooltip: Image or video frames to anchor. Multi-frame batches are anchored as a clip and cropped down to the model's valid clip lengths: 5, 22, 39... (17k + 5) frames. Batches shorter than 5 frames use only the first image.

audio.tooltip: Soundtrack to anchor starting at the same frame index, cropped to the video's remaining duration.

MiniMaxH3AddGuide.name: MiniMaxH3AddGuide
MiniMaxH3AddGuide.description: Anchor an image, a short clip, audio, or a clip with its soundtrack at any frame of a MiniMax H3 video. Chain several nodes to anchor several frames.

length.tooltip: Frame count at 24 fps, (124 = ~5s, trained range is ~124-362)

ref_image_size.tooltip: Reference image sizing. 'match' scales each ref (down only, keeping aspect) to the generation's pixel area; 'max' uses the reference pipeline's 2048px short edge for best identity fidelity. Reference tokens ride through every sampling step, so 'max' can be several times slower.

vae.tooltip: Video VAE. Without it reference images/videos only condition the text encoder.

audio_vae.tooltip: Audio VAE. Without it reference audio only conditions the text encoder.

ref_image.tooltip: Reference image (downscaled to 2048 short edge if larger, never upscaled)

ref_video_audio.tooltip: Soundtrack of the same-numbered reference video

MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo.name: MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo
MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo.description: <Picture i> / <Video k> / <Audio j> reference conditioning for MiniMax H3. Use the same tags when prompting.

encoding.tooltip: Automatic preserves compatible H.264 streams. Re-encode applies custom encoding options.

SaveVideo.name: SaveVideo
SaveVideo.description: Saves the input videos to your ComfyUI output directory.

images.tooltip: The images to create a video from.

audio.tooltip: The audio to add to the video.

bit_depth.tooltip: Auto uses 8-bit for sRGB and 10-bit for HDR. Explicit 8-bit and 10-bit choices are independent of colorspace.

color_space.tooltip: Colorspace of the input images. HDR selects BT.2020/HLG and HDR PQ selects BT.2020/PQ.

codec.tooltip: Optionally encode the video immediately. None keeps the images in tensor form; Auto uses H.264.

video.tooltip: The video to extract components from.

GetVideoComponents.name: GetVideoComponents
GetVideoComponents.description: Extracts video frames, audio, frame rate, bit depth, and color space.

PreviewAny.name: PreviewAny
PreviewAny.description: Preview any input value as text.

VRAM_Debug.name: VRAM_Debug
VRAM_Debug.description:
Returns the inputs unchanged, they are only used as triggers,  
and performs comfy model management functions and garbage collection,  
reports free VRAM before and after the operations.

width.tooltip: Exact width in width_height mode; aspect-ratio numerator in megapixels mode.

height.tooltip: Exact height in width_height mode; aspect-ratio denominator in megapixels mode.

default_seconds.tooltip: Total generation window, including repeated context. Actual length snaps to H3's frame grid.

seam_smooth.tooltip: 0 preserves raw joins for inspection; 1-4 enable extender optical-flow seam correction.

size_mode.tooltip: Megapixels scales the width:height ratio to the requested pixel area, rounding each dimension to 32. See resolution_report for the actual size.

megapixels.tooltip: Target millions of pixels per generated frame; used only in megapixels mode. Rounding makes the actual area approximate. Does not resize source references.

duration_override.tooltip: 0 inherits project duration. Otherwise 4-15 seconds, including context overlap.

steps_override.tooltip: 0 inherits project steps; positive values affect only this segment.

seed_mode.tooltip: Fixed is reproducible. Randomize chooses a fresh seed each execution. Increment/decrement start at seed and advance on subsequent executions; changing seed/mode or restarting the server resets the sequence.

images.tooltip: Decoded images from the CURRENT H3 sample. The leading pinned overlap is removed.

trim_frames.tooltip: Connect trim_frames from MiniMax H3 Context Loop Context. In head mode this removes the repeated overlap; before mode supplies 0.

audio.tooltip: Decoded audio for the same clip. Trimmed by the matching duration so sound stays locked to picture. Leave unwired for silent clips.

fps.tooltip: Frame rate used to convert the trim into an audio duration. Must match what you feed Create Video.

match_tail.tooltip: Time-conform small H3 audio-grid mismatches so duration equals frames/fps exactly without a silence tail. H3's rounded 40 Hz grid can differ from picture duration by about 8ms.

retain_overlap_frames.tooltip: Legacy/manual visual overlap for an external stitcher. In a 0.5 chain, connect Current Shot's state output below and this integer is ignored; Loop Trim then resolves the exact per-scene blend from the Plan automatically.

state.tooltip: Recommended 0.5 chain route: connect Current Shot's state output. Loop Trim reads the active scene's resolved blend directly, so a Plan default can never override a per-scene value.

MiniMaxH3LoopTrim.name: MiniMaxH3LoopTrim
MiniMaxH3LoopTrim.description: Remove the leading pinned frames from a decoded H3 clip, trimming picture and sound by the same duration. In 0.5 chains, Current Shot state also resolves the scene blend without a separate default-versus-scene integer wire.
output_tooltips: Delivered frames with the repeated leading context removed.

Audio trimmed by the same duration and, when match_tail is enabled, fitted exactly to the delivered image duration. The same AUDIO value privately carries the full decoded overlap to Segment Save so AV audio feathers survive final assembly; no extra wire is needed.
Optional blend-ready image stream. When overlap_frames is positive, this retains only the final requested part of the repeated visual context before the delivered frames. Audio remains fully trimmed.
Number of repeated leading frames retained in images_with_overlap. Use as an overlap count in a compatible video stitcher.

conditioning.tooltip: Conditioning from MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo, MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo, or TextToVideo.

latent.tooltip: Empty H3 AV latent for the NEW clip (from the conditioning node).

mode.tooltip: auto: extend if prev_frames is wired, else generate new video. disabled: bypass extend entirely. always_extend: fail if prev_frames is not wired.

context_length.tooltip: Number of frames from previous video to pin (typically 22 or 5).

encode_mode.tooltip: video: compresses motion into latent space (recommended).

anchor_mode.tooltip: head: pinned frames at start of timeline, trimmed after decode.

crop.tooltip: Crop mode when resizing context frames to target resolution.

audio_context_length.tooltip: Frames of tail audio to carry over. 0 follows context_length.

prev_frames.tooltip: Decoded frames of previous video clip (e.g. from Load Video / VAEDecode).

prev_latent.tooltip: Sampler output latent of previous clip. When connected, extracts motion guide and audio directly from the sampler latent without a lossy VAE decode/encode round-trip, preventing color drift and motion jitter.

prev_audio.tooltip: Decoded audio of previous clip (if prev_latent is not available).

audio_vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 audio VAE (required when using prev_audio).

MiniMaxH3VideoExtender.name: MiniMaxH3VideoExtender
MiniMaxH3VideoExtender.description: Extend MiniMax H3 videos seamlessly with motion & audio continuity, or pass through for new videos.
output_tooltips: Conditioning with motion context applied (or original conditioning if bypassed).
Number of pinned leading frames to trim. Wire to MiniMax H3 Contex Loop Trim.

images_b.tooltip: Current newly rendered clip frames (e.g. from Loop Trim).

images_a.tooltip: Previous clip frames (e.g. from Load Video). If empty, passes images_b through.

audio_a.tooltip: Previous clip audio (from Load Video or previous decode).

audio_b.tooltip: Current clip audio (e.g. from Loop Trim).

seam_smooth.tooltip: Anti-stutter motion smoothing at the seam boundary (0=off, 1=smooth seam frames, 2-3=smooth transition window). Eliminates frame jitter/stutter while preserving exact total frame count.

blend_frames.tooltip: Crossfade transition frames at the seam (0 = direct cut with seam_smooth). Setting >0 blends tail/head frames.

color_match.tooltip: Color correction for images_b to match images_a. 'seam_fade' (recommended) eliminates color flash/pop by matching boundary color and smoothly transitioning; 'match_mean_std' matches overall tone across the whole clip.

fps.tooltip: Frame rate for calculating audio crossfade duration when blend_frames > 0.

MiniMaxH3VideoMerge.name: MiniMaxH3VideoMerge
MiniMaxH3VideoMerge.description: Seamlessly merge previous video + current video (images & audio) with optional color matching and seam smoothing.
output_tooltips: Merged image sequence (images_a + images_b) or images_b if images_a is empty.
Merged audio track (audio_a + audio_b) or audio_b if audio_a is empty.
